patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Drip and Flodesk share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Drip and Flodesk share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Drip only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce CRM/email platform with behavior-driven automation and contact-tier pricing from” rather than Flodesk's shape. Choose Flodesk only if your buying job matches “Design-led creator ESP with beautiful templates and subscriber-tier Lite / Pro / Everythin” rather than Drip's shape. Workflow advantage: Drip leans ecommerce-email; Flodesk leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Drip and Flodesk share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Drip is Ecommerce CRM/email platform with behavior-driven automation and contact-tier pricing from $39/mo.; Flodesk is Design-led creator ESP with beautiful templates and subscriber-tier Lite / Pro / Everything plans..
- Company-size focus: Drip (small-business, mid-market) vs Flodesk (micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Drip-leaning ecommerce-email vs Flodesk-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Drip — No forever-free plan — trial-only entry from $39/mo; Flodesk — Free plan is not a full forever-free ESP send tier.

Limitations — Drip: No forever-free plan — trial-only entry from $39/mo; Contact-tier pricing rises as the store list grows; Flodesk: Free plan is not a full forever-free ESP send tier; Subscriber-tier pricing replaced legacy flat unlimited for new members.

Poor-fit cases: Drip is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever-free plan — trial-only entry from $39/mo · Flodesk is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free plan is not a full forever-free ESP send tier · Avoid Drip if you actually need Flodesk's motion (Design-led creator ESP with beautiful templates and subscriber-tier Lite / Pro /)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
